finding: Runner-sync temp framework claims can build and write `.atm/history/evidence/<temp-task>.runner-sync-receipt.json`, but the governed git commit wrapper rejects the temp task with `ATM_TASK_NOT_FOUND`, and native pre-commit rejects the receipt with `ATM_PROTECTED_STATE_EVIDENCE_FILE_MISSING_TASK_CONTEXT` because no matching task ledger/event exists.
expectedBehavior: A runner-sync steward lane must have a normal governed publication route for release artifacts and its receipt, either through a temp-task ledger record or an explicit runner-sync publication commit adapter.
evidenceOrRepro: ATM-GOV-0271 runner sync: `node atm.mjs git commit --task ATM-FRAMEWORK-TEMP-codex-skl-captain --auto-stage --json` returned `ATM_TASK_NOT_FOUND`; native path-bounded commit without `--no-verify` returned `ATM_HOOK_PRE_COMMIT_DEFERRED_GOVERNANCE_REQUIRED` with `ATM_PROTECTED_STATE_EVIDENCE_FILE_MISSING_TASK_CONTEXT`.
followUp: Create a GOV/SKL task to give framework temp claims a task-context projection or add a dedicated `runner-sync publish` adapter that commits receipt and release surfaces without emergency hook bypass.
